messages:
dana: Quick heads-up — we’re shifting the deployment rhythm for the next 3 sprints. TL;DR below, please skim and react if it impacts your team.

oliver: what’s changing exactly?

dana: Primary change: move major deploy window from Mon->Tue. New primary window = Tue 12:00–16:00 PT.
Canary window moves to Wed 10:00–13:00 PT (shorter, higher-observability).
Release freeze: starts Fri 22:00 PT and lifts Mon 06:00 PT during active sprint wrap.
Hotpatch window: Sat 09:00–11:00 PT for critical sev1/2 only (must follow hotpatch runbook).

maya: will this affect Dedicated capacity scaling / reserved pools?

dana: good call — Dedicated autoscale will still run, but we’ll avoid capacity draining during Tue noon window. Ops: no planned reservations to be drained in that window unless approved.

release-bot: [automated] New cadence policy draft uploaded: https://go/redwood/releases/cadence-draft-2026 

eden: checklist + quick links: 
- Update runbooks: https://go/redwood/runbooks/deploy 
- Canary playbook: https://go/redwood/playbooks/canary-obs 
- Hotpatch form: /forms/hotpatch-request

sanjay: I’ll update the release train board and add labels for "Tue-primary" and "Wed-canary". Also: please flag any cross-team migrations by EOD Mon.

ops-oncall: Confirmed — weekend oncall rota will cover Sat hotpatch window. If you schedule a hotpatch, ping #eng-oncall with the subject line: HOTPATCH <service>.

dana: Notes and constraints: 
- No non-critical schema migrations in Tue window.
- Feature flags: prefer server-side toggles to roll back quickly.
- Rollback policy unchanged, but practice quick rollbacks in canary before Tue.

oliver: any change to sandbox/staging cutover times?

dana: Staging cutover moves earlier to Tue 08:00 PT to allow longer soak. Sandbox remains unchanged.

eden: tagging owners: @dana @sanjay @ops-oncall — I’ll run a short sync Thurs 09:30 PT to walk the checklist.

dana: thanks — please drop any conflicts here. If none, consider this the new cadence starting next sprint. :white_check_mark:
